title: Efficient column updates (Beta)
body: Efficient Column Updates is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Add and backfill columns without rewriting unchanged columns. Workspace admins enable access from the **Previews** page. See [Efficient column updates in Delta Lake](/aws/en/tables/features/efficient-column-updates).

ref_links.text: Efficient column updates in Delta Lake
